name: Job Hunter
description: Job-board scrapers (Freelancer, Workana, Arc.dev, Gun.io, RemoteOK, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby), a deterministic curator and a dispatcher that hands the best hits to an LLM drafter.
long_description: Agent handlers for the "Jobs Hunter" office: one scraper per board stores keyword-matched ads as #job notes, the curator scores and promotes the best, and the dispatcher asks the jobs-drafter agent for a proposal per curated note. Each handler reads its tunables from its agent's variables. The office itself is created by scripts/seeds/jobs-office.ts; nothing is scheduled until then.
author: Kernl
